script.greeting: Hello. This is a call from {org_name} about your appointment.
script.prompt: You have an appointment on {date} at {time}. Press one to confirm, two to reschedule. Press nine to stop calls.
script.reprompt: Please press one to confirm your appointment or two to reschedule.
script.ack_confirm: Thank you. Your appointment is confirmed.
script.ack_decline: Thank you. Your appointment has been noted as cancelled.
script.ack_reschedule: Thank you. We will contact you to arrange another time.
script.ack_call_later: Thank you. We will call you again later.
script.ack_stop: Understood. We will not call you again.
script.ack_unclear: Sorry, we could not record your response. We may try again later.
script.voicemail: Hello, this is {org_name}. You have an appointment on {date} at {time}. Please call us to confirm.
